rows.device: Teton (HPE Cray EX, Slingshot-11, Idaho National Laboratory) - per node (derived)
rows.bench: HPL (Top500/Green500 submission), Rmax per node
rows.src_name: TOP500 / Green500 November 2026 list and system page
rows.notes: System: 393,216 cores, Rmax 20.76 PFlop/s, power 1,564.6 kW, 13.272 GFlops/W (Green500 Nov 2026, https://www.top500.org/lists/green500/list/2026/11/). Power measurement level 1. Per-node values are derived here: nodes = cores / (192 cores x 2 sockets per node, assumed) = 1,024; x and p are system totals / nodes, so p includes each node's share of interconnect (and whatever else the submission's measurement boundary covers) - not a single-node wall reading. Multi-thousand-node MPI run with vendor-tuned HPL; most of these are direct-liquid-cooled racks, so node fans are absent and facility cooling is not counted.

rows.notes: System: 262,144 cores, Rmax 15.98 PFlop/s, power 1,291.19 kW, 12.379 GFlops/W (Green500 Nov 2026, https://www.top500.org/lists/green500/list/2026/11/). Power measurement level 1. Per-node values are derived here: nodes = cores / (128 cores x 2 sockets per node, assumed) = 1,024; x and p are system totals / nodes, so p includes each node's share of interconnect (and whatever else the submission's measurement boundary covers) - not a single-node wall reading. Multi-thousand-node MPI run with vendor-tuned HPL; most of these are direct-liquid-cooled racks, so node fans are absent and facility cooling is not counted.
